generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, AI tools now sit alongside your reading, your reports and your revision, whether you study sport science, coaching, management or therapy. Knowing what they are and how they fail lets you use them as a help rather than a hazard, and using them honestly keeps your analysis your own. Treat what follows as being about your own sport work: the studies you read, the reports you write, and the declarations your course asks for, not about study in the abstract.
